Given text containing only ()[]{}, return whether all brackets close in the correct nesting order. Empty text is balanced.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "{[()]}"
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "([)]"
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

The next closer must match the most recent opener.

Complexity: O(n) time and space
